title: NeuroKit2: A Python toolbox for neurophysiological signal processing
authors: Makowski, D., Pham, T., Lau, Z. J., Brammer, J. C., Lespinasse, F., Pham, H., Schölzel, C., & Chen, S. H. A.
summary: NeuroKit2 is the lab's Python toolbox for neurophysiological signals — ECG, PPG, EDA, EMG, RSP and EEG — taking each from a raw recording to cleaned features through the same interface. It is the most widely used piece of software the lab has produced.
